title: Room to inspect a town
changes: Selecting a town and using the inspection zoom puts the town in the clear map area, away from the inspector edge.
World updates keep the current inspection view. Manual panning stays in your control; closing restores the overview only when automatic framing is still active.

title: Supplied parties at the border
changes: Civilizations can send small paid resident parties toward an exact unworked rival plot. They carry Food, move across adjacent land, and leave room for people to return.
A defender can yield or fund a response. One bounded clash can change control; inspection keeps the original purchase, current control, casualties and returns distinct.

title: Learning through working institutions
changes: Consenting partners study when both named institutions actually operate, rather than waiting for two cargo shipments. Two paid study seasons can add bounded research work.
Civilizations compare the real price and predicted completion time before offering or accepting. Route details distinguish study, payment and a completed discovery.
